verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Tseitin-formulas are systems of parity constraints whose structure is described by a graph. In this paper, we prove that a class of unsatisfiable Tseitin-formulas of bounded degree has regular resolution refutations of polynomial length if and only if the treewidth of all underlying graphs $G$ for that class is in $O(\log|V(G)|)$. verdicts.title: A sharp isoperimetric inequality in metric measure spaces with non-negative Ricci curvature
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We prove a sharp dimension-free isoperimetric inequality, involving the volume entropy, in non-compact metric measure spaces with non-negative synthetic Ricci curvature.

verdicts.title: An exact closed walks series formula for the complexity of regular graphs and some related bounds
